'''Jilka Zan Zentis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked with and was a friend of [[Besany Wennen]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] Treasury office in Corporate Tax Enforcement. She helped Besany, who she called "Bez," find information on [[Dhannut Logistics]] for the chance to double on a date with her; Bez had every intention of setting her up with [[Fi Skirata]] until he was severely wounded in the [[Battle of Gaftikar]].<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors" />

During an investigation of the [[Republic Treasury Audit Division]], the [[Gurlanin]] [[Valaqil]], in an attempt to divert the investigation away from Besany, planted evidence that framed Jilka for illegally accessing restricted information, which resulted in her being arrested by [[Republic Domestic Security]].<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors" />

Jilka was later rescued by [[Wad'e Tay'haai]], [[Walon Vau]] and [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]], who hijacked her [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] in midair, forcing it to land. This made her a fugitive from the Republic, with wanted posters hung in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] all over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She was forced to hide with Besany and Ordo. She later moved to [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Kyrimorut]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] with [[Clan Skirata]] and developed a romantic relationship with the former [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Corr Skirata|Corr]].<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel" />
